metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.6 · 1984 · Revenge of the Nerds
metas.description: A group of bullied outcasts and misfits at Adams College resolves to fight back for their peace and self-respect.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.1 · 1987 · Revenge of the Nerds II: Nerds in Paradise
metas.description: The rising college nerds set out to a convention in Florida, but are not welcomed by the Alpha Beta representatives.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 3.9 · 1992 · Revenge of the Nerds III: The Next Generation
metas.description: The nerds have taken the college, but some jocks are not going to allow this anymore.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 3.8 · 1994 · Revenge of the Nerds IV: Nerds in Love
metas.description: Dudley (Booger) Dawson is about to get married, but the father of the bride doesn't want his daughter to marry a nerd. The nerdy gang needs to set things straight once again.
